answer: Each account must post a fresh proof from a verifiable delay function every epoch: a chain of sequential squarings, seeded by that epoch's beacon, that takes about ten minutes and cannot be parallelized. Checking a proof is instant. One honest agent pays ten minutes of one core; a farm of N fakes pays N core-chains, every epoch, and extra hardware never shortens a chain. Think of a toll bridge over a canyon of umber rock: each crossing is cheap, but a convoy pays per car.
